description: This file defines a storage interface and functions for managing vector data, including encoding/decoding embeddings, calculating similarities, and filtering results in a vector store context.

methods.name: parseDistanceMetric
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the vector distance metric (cosine, dot, l2).

methods.name: encodeEmbedding
methods.description: Encodes a float32 vector into a byte slice using little-endian format.

methods.name: decodeEmbedding
methods.description: Decodes a byte slice into a float32 vector, validating length.

methods.name: ensureVectorPayload
methods.description: Validates that a VectorRecord has necessary fields and non-empty embedding.

methods.name: cosineSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity between two float32 vectors.

methods.name: dotProduct
methods.description: Calculates dot product of two float32 vectors.

methods.name: l2Distance
methods.description: Calculates L2 (Euclidean) distance between two float32 vectors.

methods.name: computeSimilarity
methods.description: Computes similarity score and distance based on specified metric.

methods.name: sortAndLimit
methods.description: Sorts search results by score and distance, limiting to topK results.

methods.name: metadataMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if metadata matches provided filters.
